searchText: I have a question regarding geth. Is this the correct place to ask? <@783977469077094421> depends what your question is, but go ahead and ask Thanks <@543900561460822016> ! I'm having trouble exposing geth's `authrpc` endpoint 8551, so it's basically a networking issue. Specifically, this is the command i'm running: ``` geth --goerli --http --http.addr=127.0.0.1 \ --http.port=8545 --http.vhosts="*" --http.api="eth,net,engine,rpc,web3" \ --authrpc.jwtsecret="jwt.hex" --authrpc.addr=http://127.0.0.1 --authrpc.port=8551 \ --authrpc.vhosts="*" --http.rpcprefix=/ ``` The above maybe having a lot of flags but i'm trying out all of them to be sure. The issue is that the endpoint `http://127.0.0.1:8551` is unreachable although `http://127.0.0.1:8545` is reachable. PS: My geth node is fully synced. Any thoughts on what i maybe doing wrong? AFAIK Geth won’t open the engine port until a TTD is defined. A release with that defined for Goerli should happen in the next day or two <@783977469077094421> 🙂 That's very helpful, thanks <@84562395988508672> 🙏

Thanks <@543900561460822016> !

I'm having trouble exposing geth's `authrpc` endpoint 8551, so it's basically a networking issue. Specifically, this is the command i'm running:

```
geth --goerli --http --http.addr=127.0.0.1 \
--http.port=8545 --http.vhosts="*" --http.api="eth,net,engine,rpc,web3" \
--authrpc.jwtsecret="jwt.hex" --authrpc.addr=http://127.0.0.1 --authrpc.port=8551 \
--authrpc.vhosts="*" --http.rpcprefix=/
```

The above maybe having a lot of flags but i'm trying out all of them to be sure.

The issue is that the endpoint `http://127.0.0.1:8551` is unreachable although `http://127.0.0.1:8545` is reachable.
PS: My geth node is fully synced.

Any thoughts on what i maybe doing wrong?

excerpts.author: samcm
excerpts.content: AFAIK Geth won’t open the engine port until a TTD is defined. A release with that defined for Goerli should happen in the next day or two <@783977469077094421> 🙂
